checks.text: Dragging on the canvas with the brush changes canvas pixels along the path (read them back with `getImageData`).
Choosing a different color from the palette changes the color of the next stroke.
The size slider changes stroke width; a wider stroke covers more pixels than a narrow one.
The eraser tool clears pixels it passes over.
Undo (button and Ctrl/Cmd+Z) removes the last stroke; Redo (button and Shift+Ctrl/Cmd+Z) restores it.
Clear empties the canvas, and Undo brings the drawing back.
Export PNG downloads a file named `paint-<date>.png` (assert with Playwright's download event).
Every tool, the palette, and the size control work from the keyboard; the selected tool is announced with `aria-pressed`.
